story_short: Occasionally we would go into Manchester on the bus, the route took us past the Central Library and Town Hall. I always assumed these buildings were made of black stone, it wasn't until many years later after they had been cleaned that I realised they were covered in soot and were in fact made from creamy Portland Stone.
story_raw:
"I was born in Urmston, Manchester in 1956 - although at that time and until 1972, officially it was in Lancashire.
However, Urmston was by then a suburb of Manchester, the inhabitants mostly worked in Manchester or in the factories of nearby Trafford Park.
The view from my bedroom window looked out over allotments towards Trafford Park, I could see many chimneys, (it's a long time ago but I think I counted 28), belonging to the factories, the largest being those belonging to Barton Power Station. They were all fuelled by coal.
Whenever my mum hung washing out she would first wipe the line down because the line itself was sooty and would transfer grubby marks onto the washing where it was attached to the line.
Occasionally we would go into Manchester on the bus, the route took us past the Central Library and Town Hall. I always assumed these buildings were made of black stone, it wasn't until many years later after they had been cleaned that I realised they were covered in soot and were in fact made from creamy Portland Stone. Also when I was very young we would pass the shells of buildings bombed in the Second World War.
I recently caught the bus into Manchester along the very same route - it took almost an hour, a journey which used to take 30 minutes taking twice as long because of the amount of traffic. I think the pollution from cars, trucks etc must be the bigger problem now.
I have had asthma since I was a child, never serious enough to be hospitilised, I was lucky as my parents didn't smoke. For the last 40 years I have lived in Ormskirk a small market town in Lancashire, about 15 miles north of Liverpool. I think it is healthier here - I never have to wipe my washing line clean."
pollution_type_described: sooty washing line; buildings covered in soot
impact_themes: washing and cleanliness; moving away from pollution
